title: Slovakian Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian stew made with tender chicken, sweet carrots, and a hint of paprika.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

ingredients.name: slovakian stew
ingredients.notes: Available at Eastern European or specialty stores

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of Slovakian stew in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
